Trinity Realty and Trinau Inc. could not be reviewed beyond search results: one serves a JavaScript bot challenge, the other an invalid TLS certificate. I did not attempt to bypass either.

Trinity Realty, Trinau Inc. and MKA Staffing rely on search-snippet or own-site text for part of their service description; where that is the case the source is cited.
Phone screenshots were captured at 390px emulation in Chrome; visual judgements about mobile layout come from those screenshots.

Trinity Realty site content, forms, schema and mobile layout unknown - blocked by WAF challenge (HTTP 403 to fetch, 'We couldn't verify your browser' in Chrome).
